title: HAWK Beacon Final Phase (Alternating Wig-Wag Flashing Red): Stop Completely First, Then Proceed Only If Crosswalk Is Empty!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All visible vehicles face forward away from viewer in same direction; no opposing vehicles in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No vehicle interior or steering wheel is visible to judge drive side.

single_bulb_signal.note: Overhead HAWK shows four red lenses lit simultaneously, two on left housing and two on right housing, not at most one lit.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Yellow double centerline on left of travel lane, white edge line/curb on right, vehicles traveling forward on right side.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; roadside signs, store signs, and license plate are blank shapes.

scene_match.note: Empty mid-block HAWK crosswalk with red beacons present, but sedan is positioned on top of crosswalk stripes, not stopped behind the white bar, and beacons show steady all-red not alternating.

result.summary: Fails single-bulb rule with four simultaneous reds and teaches wrong stopping position on crosswalk instead of behind bar.

teaching_correct.note: Teaches stopping on/over the crosswalk stripes rather than fully behind the stop bar, blocking the crosswalk, plus misrepresents wig-wag as four simultaneous reds.

result.what_i_see: A black sedan viewed from behind sits directly on a mid-block zebra crosswalk under an overhead gantry with four lit red lenses, with empty roadway ahead and sidewalks on both sides.
